name: Oniboku ~Oni Musume Inkan~
source:
Shouta lives in a mountain village far away from cities.
One day, he happens to find a mummy stored in an old hut.
It is his carelessness that he touches it and awakens an ogre inside......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE240346.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
翔太住在远离城市的山村。某天，他在旧小屋中发现一具木乃伊。由于粗心，他碰到了木乃伊，唤醒了里面的鬼怪……
